name: ad-delayer
cost: Free API key. Each run is billed; prices are not stated in the README
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Codex and 37+ other agents
short: Turns a flat, finished ad image back into editable layers: background, product, logo, headline, copy and call to action.
what: Sends a finished ad to Bria's Ad Delayer and gets it back as separate layers, plus a `result.json` that records where each layer sits, how big it is and how its text is styled. Each piece of text comes back twice, as an exact outlined SVG and as editable text, so you can change a headline, a price or the language.
who: Marketers and designers who need to resize, re-price or translate an ad when the original design file is lost. If you only need a background removed, the skill points you to Bria's separate remove-background skill.
needs: A Bria API key, free to create at platform.bria.ai
A coding agent that supports skills
Ads up to 2048 px on each side. Bigger ones need an enterprise plan

steps.title: In Claude Code, add the marketplace and install
Or install Bria's skills into other agents
Set your key
steps.text: Or just start using it, and the skill walks you through signing in.

try.label: From the README
try.text:
Turn this ad into layers: /path/to/summer-sale.jpg

The layers and result.json land in a summer-sale-layers folder.

watch: Each run is a billed job that takes 2 to 3 minutes. The skill says not to resubmit the same ad by hand after a failure.
Your ad is sent to Bria's API for processing.
Signing in saves your access token and API key in `~/.bria/credentials`.
The default limit is 9 delayering runs a minute per account.
